database_query_sql.coverage: select split_part(o.geography_key,':',2) province,s.source_system,s.metric_type,min(o.time)::date first_date,max(o.time)::date last_date,count(*) observations,count(distinct o.time::date) dates,count(distinct o.series_code) series,count(distinct s.disease_id) concepts,max(o.updated_at) last_modified from disease_series_observations o join disease_surveillance_series s using(series_code) where o.geography_key like 'country:CN-%:national' group by 1,2,3 order by 1,2,3
database_query_sql.months: select split_part(o.geography_key,':',2) province,to_char(o.time,'YYYY-MM') period_month,s.source_system,s.metric_type,count(*) observations,count(distinct s.source_series_code) series,count(distinct s.disease_id) concepts from disease_series_observations o join disease_surveillance_series s using(series_code) where o.geography_key like 'country:CN-%:national' group by 1,2,3,4 order by 1,2,3,4
database_query_sql.public: select country_code,count(*) series,min(period_start) first_date,max(period_end) last_date,sum(point_count) points,max(updated_at) updated_at from public_disease_series where country_code like 'CN-%' group by 1 order by 1
database_query_sql.jobs: select job_id,name,country_code,source,enabled,process,fill_missing,force,revision_window_months,retry_threshold,interval_minutes,daily_time,timezone,notes from automation_jobs where country_code like 'CN-%' order by country_code,source
database_query_sql.states: select s.job_kind,s.job_id,s.next_run_at,s.last_started_at,s.last_finished_at,s.last_status,s.last_error from scheduled_job_states s where s.job_id in (select job_id from automation_jobs where country_code like 'CN-%') order by s.job_id
database_query_sql.runs: select * from (select country_code,source,status,started_at,finished_at,total_records,processed_reports,error_message,metadata,row_number() over(partition by country_code,source order by started_at desc) rn from crawl_runs where country_code like 'CN-%') r where rn<=2 order by country_code,source,rn

2026-10页面：https://wjw.shanxi.gov.cn/zfxxgk/fdzdgknr/yqfb/202611/t20261112_10258428.shtml

现有crawler生成HFRS=0，但 `Raw.explicit_narrative_value` 是“中东呼吸综合征（MERS）、埃博拉出血热、寨卡病毒病、拉沙热无发病、死亡报告”。全文只有该句中的“埃博拉出血热”，乙类无病例名单不含“出血热/流行性出血热/肾综合征出血热”。因此本次生成HFRS零是别名子串匹配导致的无直接支持零；不能据此断言真实HFRS病例大于零。此为本次只读解析输出，未入库。

2026-09页面：https://wjw.shanxi.gov.cn/zfxxgk/fdzdgknr/yqfb/202610/t20261014_10235479.shtml

补验全文：乙类零名单明确包含“出血热”，同时非法定疾病零名单有“埃博拉出血热”。因此若数据库9月HFRS零证据挂在埃博拉句，属于证据错挂，数值本身仍有另一句独立支持。不能把所有出现埃博拉证据的历史月份直接认定为数值错误；应逐月复核。补验原文保存为 `CN-SX_202609_extra.html`。
